title: Contact
author: Carl Sagan
summary: A radio astronomer who has spent her career listening for signals from space finally hears one, from the star Vega. Humanity must decide how to respond to a message that contains instructions for building something.
readIf: you like hopeful, idea-led science fiction about science, faith and being curious.
skipIf: you want action and aliens early, because much of the book is about people debating what to do.

pairings.reason: A darker modern book about humanity's first signals from the stars, with far more dread.
A more playful, lively story of a human who has to work with an alien to save the world.
A more mysterious and visionary take on humanity's encounter with something greater.
